_SAFE_HEADERS = frozenset(
    {
        "accept",
        "accept-encoding",
        "accept-language",
        "cache-control",
        "connection",
        "content-length",
        "content-type",
        "host",
        "user-agent",
    }
)


def _redact_headers(headers: httpx.Headers) -> dict[str, str]:
